python_defect: A JSON string escape for a lone UTF-16 surrogate is valid JSON and reaches pydantic, which rejects the address and echoes it in the 422 body. Starlette then cannot encode that body as UTF-8 and the request ends with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (UnicodeEncodeError in starlette.responses.JSONResponse.render).
rust_behaviour: serde_json refuses a lone surrogate escape, so the body is rejected as invalid JSON with HTTP 422 `json_invalid` before any address validation. Rust never answers 500 for this input.
evidence: referral-invite-addresses twin run on the staging test host, 19 Oct 2026: the Python cell answered 500 to vector `lone-high-surrogate-local-part` on POST /api/referrals/invite (traceback ends in the UnicodeEncodeError named above). The other vectors share the mechanism, because the 422 body always echoes the input; they were not run separately.
